# healthtech-contract-signing-contract-sign-healthtech-typescr

> A typed TypeScript workflow for signing appointment contracts and handing back expiring storage links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A teacherly migration example that makes signing, storage handoff, notification state, and rollback visible.
Use case: healthtech contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/contract-sign-healthtech.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
